title: Choose the visual world (re-roll 1)
question: Pin: whole tool on one page (profile + requirements + recommendation + quote visible together). The roll assigned Official Application Form. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Official Application Form
options.lineage: single-sheet government and enterprise application forms
options.thesis: One ruled form sheet: every field and checkbox stays visible; the € recommendation is the official approval block.
options.viewport: ONE PAGE: top bar; left profile+all requirement checkboxes in ruled sections; right sticky approval block with mono €57.20; quote table full width below—nothing hidden behind tabs.
options.risk: Can feel bureaucratic if the stamp outranks the live calculator feel.

raised.raise: Panels persist: toggling never replaces the layout; the whole sheet stays on screen.
Filled money figures strike in carbon-purple mono so prices read as entered facts.

options.label: Pink Markets Page
options.thesis: Licensing as a markets page: dense columns, prices everywhere, one sheet you scan.
options.viewport: ONE PAGE: pink ground; requirements as dense market columns; recommendation as lead quote €57.20; quote table as the listings strip—all visible together.
options.risk: Familiar category landing: serious finance paper most runs reach for.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference
options.lineage: reference-setting pages with centre key rail and wide annotation margin
options.thesis: Two requirement columns flank a fixed centre rail of keys and the live € decision—whole page stays open.
options.viewport: ONE PAGE: left/right requirement columns; centre rail with SKU keys and €57.20; quote apparatus in the margin/below—never a single-panel takeover.
options.case: Beats the roll on clarity for your one-page pin and holds consultant identification via reference reading.
options.risk: Costume if the ruling engine becomes decoration instead of structure.

options.label: Exposure Record Sheets
options.lineage: darkroom printer exposure records with translucent overlays
options.thesis: Requirements as the base sheet; As-Is/To-Be as translucent overlays with stop-deltas on price.
options.viewport: ONE PAGE: base form always visible; overlay slides for Compare without replacing the field; €57.20 with stop-delta.
options.case: Holds clarity for layered compare; weaker everyday audience ID than forms.
options.risk: Darkroom metaphor can obscure if overlays hide the base sheet.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Scan bands for decisions; gate-number scale for the € price; paths stay signed on one concourse page.
options.viewport: ONE PAGE: yellow decision bands over a full work field of requirements; monumental €57.20; quote as next-gate strip—all still on one surface.
options.case: Holds scan clarity; loses on price-culture identification and risks ‘playful’ yellow.
options.risk: Yellow can feel playful against your brief if not strictly reserved for wayfinding jobs.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: airline ticket wallets with carbon-copy coupons
options.case: Loses both: coupon tear-flow fights one-page overview; travel ephemera reads playful.
options.kept: Carbon-struck numerals for filled money figures.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: Peter Saville Factory Records catalog identity
options.case: Loses both: coded labels hide meaning; fights price-first clarity.
options.kept: Ruthless reduction—one decoded focal line for the live SKU.

options.label: Dark-First Console
options.case: Loses both as tool-costume on an Operate screen; not consultant paper culture.
options.kept: Tiled panels persist—navigation never replaces the whole layout.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Incumbent one-page SaaS calculator executed at full craft: left requirements, right recommendation, quote below.
canonCard.viewport: ONE PAGE exactly like today’s topology, polished—not glass costume, not a wizard.
canonCard.risk: Closest to current; change is craft, not structure.
